from pathlib import Path
import os, re, subprocess
p=Path('core/agents/lastfm.go')
candidate=p.read_text()
try:
    disabled, count=re.subn(r'\tif l\.shouldRetry\([^\n]+\) \{\n\t\treturn [^\n]+\n\t\}\n', '', candidate)
    assert count == 3, count
    p.write_text(disabled)
    env=dict(os.environ, GOPROXY='off', GOMAXPROCS='2')
    result=subprocess.run(['go','test','-p','1','./core/agents','-run','^TestLastFMFallback$','-count=1'], env=env, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=45)
    print(result.stdout)
    print('Fallback-disabled regression check exit:', result.returncode)
    if result.returncode != 1 or 'requests = 1, want 2' not in result.stdout:
        raise SystemExit('Regression check did not fail in the expected way')
finally:
    p.write_text(candidate)
PY
